description: This file contains the implementation of a NetlinkClient class for interacting with Linux netlink sockets, including methods for sending requests, opening sockets, and processing responses, as well as a factory for creating instances.

classes.name: NetlinkClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the NetlinkClient interface for Linux netlink socket communication.

classes.name: NetlinkClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: Factory class for creating NetlinkClient instances.

methods.name: CheckResponse
methods.description: Checks the response from the netlink socket for a specific sequence number, handling errors and completion signals.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink request message through the socket and waits for a response.

methods.name: OpenNetlink
methods.description: Initializes and opens a netlink socket of a specified type.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new NetlinkClient instance of a specified type, opening the socket and returning the instance.
